itemList.description:
PART-A:OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE MVS Scheme to Marikoppa and other17 Villages in Honnali Taluk,Davanagere District for 1st Year to 5th Year : Operation and maintenance of the scheme, which includes, providing technical staff, valveman, operators, and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials & chemcials required, for operation of jack wells / WTP /pipeline repair works 1. Regular maintenance of civil structures like Jack well form WTP, PWS, Master balancing tank, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintenance of civil structures consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, however painting for civil structures shall be once in a year. 2. Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line, valves etc.if found necessary. It includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water rising main, gravity mains, pure water rising mains. maintaining the required discharge in the each pipe including controlling all the valves so that each village will get required designed quantum of water. 3. Operation and maintenance of water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of alum ,chlorine and other chemicals including replacement of sand / filter media as required as per standard of established norms from time to time. Maintaining the quality of water as per the guide lines CPHEEO mannual and ISI specifications including cost of testing of water at laboratory at regular intervals. 4. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, other mechanical components of this scheme including SCADA, electrical maintenance covering all repairs / replacement of transformers / Electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts of machinery All the above repairs & maintenace will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitatants of the Project villages. Note: Helpers / Watchman / Valve man / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at Jackwell, WTP and Pure water Sump points. The contactor should maintain a Log Book on the working of pumping machinery at Jackwell, WTP etc. The payment will be made by the Engineer-in-charge satisfactoty report.
The bidder shall quote for the 5year O & M cost against the total estimated cost of Rs.31738648.00The year wise breakup amount shall be calculated as per the percentage given below. 
Year 1: 18.10% 
Year 2: 19.00%
Year 3: 19.95%
Year 4: 20.95%
Year 5: 22.00%

DETAILED ESTIMATE FOR BULK FLOW METERS - WTP, ZBT's, & Village O.H.Ts: Supplying and fixing DI Resilient seated soft sealing SLUICE VALVE of variouis dia. with body bonnet of ductile iron (DI) conforming to IS-1865 and of grade GGG 40/50, shaft of stainless steel, wedge fully rubber lined with EDPM seals of NBR and the valves should be vacum tight and 100% leak proof with face to face dimensions as per IS 14846-2000 only. The stem sealing should be with toroidal sealing rings (minimum 2 O rings). Body and bonut should be coated with Electrostatically applied Epoxy Powder Coating with minimum coating thickness of 250 micron both inside and outside. The rate is inclusive of cost of valves, T.P set, galvanized bolts & nuts and rubber insertions etc. but excluding earth work. (Note: TP set should be considered only for DI pipes estimate. Supply and fixing of Horizontal Mechanical Woltman type hemetically sealed water meters with copper Glass register with IP 68 protection. The meter shall be removable mechanism type manufactured as ISO 4064-1:1993 with MID certification. The meters shall be capable of transmitting consumption data on daily basis to central server through GSM/GPRS. The meter interface unit shall be fitted to the meter without wire. detection. The data logger shall also send alams on blocked meter, flow rate above limit, pressure below or above limits. a) for 150mm di
